items.prompt: You talk to a police officer you don't know. Which word for “you”?
items.explanation: With a stranger in a formal situation, use usted.
optionNotes: Tú is for friends, family and people your age.
Vosotros is for a group, not one person.

items.explanation: A mixed group takes the masculine form, even with one man: ellos.
optionNotes: Ellas is only for a group of women.

items.prompt: In Mexico, you talk to two friends. Which word for “you”?
items.explanation: In Latin America, ustedes is the word for every group, friends included.
optionNotes: Vosotros is used for friends in Spain only.

items.prompt: Which sentence sounds most natural as an answer to “¿Cómo te llamas?”
items.explanation: The verb already shows the person, so the pronoun yo is left out unless you want contrast.
optionNotes: Correct grammar, but yo is extra here; use it only for contrast or emphasis.
Él se llama talks about another man.
Tú te llamas means “you are called”.
